title: Cr3C2/Cr2O3 dual-phase surface engineering of graphite felt for enhanced conductivity and catalytic activity in vanadium redox flow batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00259E, Paper
Hao Tung Lin, Shu-Mei He, Liang-Hong Liu, Li-Tao Teng
Conductive Cr3C2 and hydrophilic Cr2O3 form a dual-phase surface on graphite felt, reducing charge-transfer resistance and enabling efficient, stable vanadium redox flow batteries at high current density.
